name: The Carried Tally
description: A bone tally carries complete benchmark evidence for another worker to replay.
method: Built-in image generation edited the inherited wall; only a small bounded patch was copied into the original. Existing local PNG/JPEG finishing code generated the outputs.

review.hand_check: Both ancestral Pepes have concealed hands. No visible fingers or hand stencils; no new hands were added.
review.earth_pigments: chalk white, charcoal black and red ochre added on warm rock

limits: Local visual inspection is not independent approval.
The generator supplied patch rock; original rock and all paint outside the patch are byte-identical.
